title: Caught
blurb: A market hall at closing time, a pieman, a watchman, and a hungry child with a plan.
after: What you take, people see. Giving back and paying makes it right; a fair trade or honest work makes it yours.
refines: Do players read ownership and consequences? Does the watch respond fairly (accuse, demand, forgive, seize)?
goal: Get a pie of your own

steps.title: Wendford market hall
cards: …signal. A market hall at closing time. You're hungry and you have no money.
Osk sells pies. Hobb the watchman is hunting a pie thief. People see what you do, and someone seen taking what isn't theirs is accused, chased, made to give it back, or thrown out.
There's no one right way, and no words to copy. The device helps if you ask (H).

steps.title: Supper
cards: Get yourself a pie: one that's yours. A pie you've only taken isn't yours.
steps.task: Get a pie of your own
steps.done: Yours, fairly. However you came by it, the hall saw how.

playtest.say: I've no money, but I'll work for a pie. Is there anything needs doing?
